Honest answer: I'm not going to guess on that one. Harlo OS is bundled with our Harlo units, and I can't confirm it runs on the Nano 3S or on GekkoScience hardware, which ships with Gekko's own stack.

I've put it to the team — someone will jump in here, or email you if you step away. Meanwhile, is the KBOX the one you're leaning toward?
